description: This file is a shell script that contains tests and setup code for verifying integration between Git, Subversion (svn), and git-svn properties, especially focusing on svn:keywords, svn:eol-style, and svn:ignore properties. It automates repository creation, commits, property setting, and verification steps for the version control interaction.

methods.name: test_propget
methods.description: A helper shell function defined within the script to fetch and compare svn property values for different files and directories, used during verification steps.
